item.title: Millers All Day Hospitality to Open Jimmy Rosso Pizza in Brickyard Plantation this Summer
item.description: The hospitality team behind several Charleston restaurant concepts will open its newest project, Jimmy Rosso, in summer 2026 at the entrance of Brickyard Plantation in North Mount Pleasant.

item.title: SCETV to Livestream South Carolina Supreme Court Oral Arguments in Alex Murdaugh Appeal
item.description: South Carolina ETV and Public Radio (SCETV) will livestream oral arguments before the Supreme Court of South Carolina in The State v. Richard Alexander Murdaugh on Feb. 11 beginning at 9:30 a.m.

item.title: Charleston Battery’s 2026 preseason schedule with MLS, USL, college sides confirmed
